limitations: No verified active execution intervals: response envelopes and gap caps are proxies, not active time.
Native closed cohort includes unsuccessful closure; native completion is not harmonized quality acceptance.
Timestamp data are partial telemetry, with unknown terminal coverage; no assertion full worked-time-to-done.
No automatic outlier exclusion, no measured pause adjustment without supported intervals.
Bootstrap conditions on selected cohort and observed parent components; missing dependencies can understate uncertainty.
First observed dispatch may follow actual work; creation, boundary and current bodies are separate.
No causal effects or cross-profile latent invariance established.
